{{Quote|Well, just popped us into hyperspace. We ought to hit Gyndine in a couple of hours. It's late in the season, but hopefully their grain market can stand one more hold full of denta beans.|[[Danna]] to [[Gabriel]]|<ref name="Galaxywide NewsNets">{{JournalCite|3|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>}}
'''Denta beans''' were a type of bean. [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] was shipping some to [[Taanab/Legends|Taanab]] just prior to the [[Battle of Taanab/Legends|Battle of Taanab]].

Denta beans were one of the top one hundred cash crops grown on [[Factory/Legends|factory]] [[Farm/Legends|farms]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
